mutations.name: a stale base script passes
kills: applyEdit refuses an edit drafted on another script than the base run's

mutations.name: custom-layer beats are editable
kills: applyEdit refuses a beat the script lacks and a custom-layer beat, naming each

mutations.name: a cue's target may be renamed away
kills: applyEdit refuses renaming or deleting an element a cue targets, naming the cue

mutations.name: the edit writes outside visual
kills: applyEdit writes an accepted edit into visual.slots and visual.tune only, and diffs each field against what the render saw

mutations.name: a beat edit may carry other fields
kills: applyEdit refuses an edit to anything outside slots and tune, naming the field
